name: Code Candy Floating Indicator Nav
useWhen: A project needs a dark navigation bar with a green floating active indicator that appears and moves only after user selection.
implementationNotes: Start with no active state unless the product has a real default route.
Move the indicator on click, Enter, or Space only.
Keep each nav target accessible with aria-label and aria-pressed/current state.
Do not let hidden scenes intercept clicks when used inside a gallery.
reducedMotion: Move the active indicator instantly and keep the selected icon in a readable static position.
avoid: using this for large desktop primary nav without adaptation
green glow on inaccessible contrast backgrounds
